sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:45)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Arrived at office and doing debrief with night shift before heading out on patrol.
All geared up and heading out on patrol towards Aotea Square. (Will be conducting welfare checks on businesses during patrol towards check-in areas.)
Starbucks, Localito, Queen St McDonald's and 77 Convenience Store all clear. All stores checked have just opened. Continuing towards Aotea Square.
Arrived at Aotea Square and commencing a sweep of the area.
Area is all clear, standing by for security presence.
Library area is all clear. Heading up Wellesley St towards Federal St.
Arrived at the corner of Victoria and Federal St. Welfare checks completed on Eighty Fed, both 77 Convenience Store, Coffee Club and News Agency store. Standing by for security presence.
Heading towards Darby via Elliot and Victoria St.
Elliot and Darby St all clear, heading towards Lorne St via Wellesley St.
Lorne St all clear. Heading towards High St.
High St, Freyberg Square, Vulcan Lane all clear. Heading towards Chancery Square via O'Connell St.
Chancery Square all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Received a call from Jo&Joes about a female POI yelling in their lobby. Heading there now.
The POI had left before we arrived. Heading towards Britomart to look for the POI.
Arrived at Britomart, no signs of the POI. Checking in on Britomart McDonald's.
All clear, standing by for security presence.
Heading to check on TK Square and Commercial Bay.
Commercial Bay and TK Square all clear. Checking in on Lower Albert Woolworths.
All clear. Standing by for security presence.
Albert Mart is all clear. Continuing patrol.
Arrived at the Cathedral, commencing sweep.
Cathedral all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Heading towards Victoria St via Federal St.
Received a call from Queen St Typo informing us of a POI who attempted to steal from them. Heading there now.
Arrived at Typo and got the description of the POI. We didn't see her on our way towards the store; she was seen heading up Queen St. Heading towards Aotea Square to look for the POI.
Arrived at Aotea Square. Checked on stores from Typo till Aotea Square, no sign of the POI. Heading to HQ to charge the Ops phone.
Arrived at the office now charging Ops phone, it's on 5%.
Received a call from Lush regarding a female POI playing her music too loud. Heading there now.
Got the female to move along but she's at a public bench. Standing by for security presence. (photo/video on file)
Keeping eyes on POI. (video on file)
Received a call from Dangerfield regarding the same female POI playing her music and disrupting business operations. Heading back there now.
Council Wardens are on site, heading over to assist.
After numerous attempts to make her comply she eventually went away really fast after seeing the police approaching. Standing by for security presence.
Welfare check on Chemist Warehouse, all clear.
Welfare checks on stores from Kathmandu down to Britomart McDonald's all clear, no issues to report. Standing by for security presence.
Heading towards Victoria St via Albert St.
Arrived on Albert St. All stores from Remarkable Gifts Auckland all the way to Skymart Supermarket all clear, no issues to report. Heading down to check on Woolworths.
Woolworths all clear. Heading towards Elliot St.
Elliot St all clear. Broken mirror found under the public bench. Heading towards Darby St. (photo on file)
Mirrou called about a suspicious female in their store. (photo on file)
Arrived on site, standing by for security presence.
POI has left the store and purchased her items.
Same female playing her music loudly next to Kiwiana. She left after seeing police. Standing by for security presence. The female POI has gone down Durham St. (photo on file)
Heading to the office to have break.
Received a call from Britomart McDonald's asking for assistance with a male vagrant drinking and yelling in public.
Arrived at Britomart McDonald's, no sign of the POI. High police presence due to protest. Heading back to office for changeover.
Arrived at the office, shift changeover completed.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:45 – 21:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.
Very heavy presence in the area, having a little debrief before showing presence on Queen Street.

Received a response call from The Warehouse on Elliot Street regarding a male individual who walked out the store with stolen products; the caller notified us he walked down Queen Street. Patrolling down Queen Street to potentially find the described male.
Patrolling down Queen Street to find the suspected male individual with stolen products.
After a long search we were not successful in finding the individual who shoplifted from The Warehouse. Heading to The Warehouse to retrieve photo evidence.
Arrived at The Warehouse, footage could not be retrieved due to a store policy. Continuing patrols.
Welfare check Elliot Street, Elliot Stables, Elliot Atrium shopping centre, Elliot carpark, all clear.
Arrived at Aotea Square, very heavy presence, commencing sweep while maintaining presence.
Currently still at Aotea Square maintaining presence and sweeping.
Full sweep Aotea Square, welfare check on businesses, all clear. Patrolling down Lorne Street.
Welfare check Rutland Street, all clear. Patrolling down Lorne Street.
Welfare check Central City Library, all clear, no issues. Continuing patrols.
Welfare check Lorne staircase mural, all clear, welfare checking on all businesses on Lorne Street.
Full sweep Lorne Street, welfare checks on all businesses, all clear, no issues. Patrolling down Lorne Street.
Arrived at Freyberg commencing full sweep.
Welfare check O'Connell and all businesses, all clear. Proceeding to Chancery Square.
Welfare check Chancery Street, all clear. Arrived at Chancery Square commencing sweep.
Standing down patrols, received a response call from Loom Sharp Victoria Street regarding 3 male individuals inside the premises acting suspicious. On route to location.
When we arrived the 3 male individuals were already walking out the store empty handed with no stolen goods. Welfare check on Loom Sharp, all clear. Continuing patrols back on High Street.
Full sweep Freyberg Pl, Chancery Square, welfare check on all businesses open, all clear. Patrolling down High Street.
Welfare check Vulcan Lane and all businesses open, all clear.
Full sweep High Street, welfare checks all clear. Patrolling down Fort Lane.
Welfare check Shortland Street and all stores seen, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check Evans Kebabs, KFC, The Right Track, Jo&Joes, Vape Haven, all clear, no issues. Patrolling down Lorne Street.
Welfare check Seoul Night, Angus Steakhouse, Snickel Lane centre, all clear. Patrolling to Britomart.
Arrived at Britomart, heavy presence, maintaining presence while commencing sweep.
Currently still at Britomart standing by maintaining presence.

Full sweep Britomart, welfare check Quay Street downtown waterfront, Commercial shopping centre, Lower Albert Street and all businesses open, all clear. Heading back to office to standby for floor checks.
Arrived at headquarters standing by for floor checks.
Received a call from management requesting security go to Bar 101 to welfare check on the owner. On route to location.
Welfare check Bar 101, all clear, no issues. Heading to headquarters to commence floor checks.
Welfare check Celines, Thai Food, Pizza Club. Standing by at Darby station maintaining presence.
Welfare check Darby station, all clear. Heading back to headquarters to let management inside level 7.
Management inside level 7, all clear. Continuing patrols up Victoria Street.
Victoria Street all clear, welfare check 77 Convenience Store, Skymart Convenience, all clear, no issues. Patrolling Federal Street.
Federal Street all clear. Arrived at Federal Square commencing sweep.
Full sweep Federal Square, welfare check Cathedral and Liston House, all clear, no issues. Patrolling down Swanson St.
Welfare check Swanson St West, all clear. Patrolling down Albert Street.
Welfare check Albert Mart Convenience Store, all clear.
Albert Street all clear. Patrolling down Lower Albert St.
Lower Albert Street all clear. Arriving at Commercial Bay / Britomart to commence sweep.
Full sweep Britomart, welfare check McDonald's, all clear, no issues. Heading back to headquarters for 30 minute break.
Full sweep Queen Street, no issues. Arrived at headquarters commencing break while charging ops phone.
Received a response call from Darby Street station regarding a male individual coming out of the premises and threatening our fellow security guards. On route to location.
Arrived at response location, notified the individual has walked up Queen Street. Patrolling the area to potentially spot the individual.
After a hard search the individual was not found. Heading back to headquarters to continue break.
Welfare check Timezone, ChaCha, McDonald's Queen Street, Localito, Avachi Chicken n Kebab, all clear. Heading back to headquarters.
Arrived at headquarters standing by waiting for guard handover.
Currently standing by in office for guard handover.
Afternoon shift concluded, handing over to Night shift.

sections.title: Night Shift (21:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
On standby at HQ awaiting 2nd guard.
Second guard arrived. On standby charging ops phone.
Heading out on patrols, charged phone up to 57%.
On standby at Darby St / Elliot St showing security presence due to heavy foot traffic at Bar 101.
Bar 101 no issues, police doing bar checks.
Patrolling Aotea Square commencing full sweep.
Aotea Square full sweep complete, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check Munster Inn, no issues to report. Heading down Queen St commencing full sweep.
Welfare check Queen St Maccas / Cue City / Avachi, no issues to report.
Welfare check QF Tavern / Chemist Warehouse / Kathmandu, no issues. Heading to Sapphire through Shortland St.
Welfare check Sapphire, on standby showing presence.
Sapphire all clear, quiet down now, no issues to report.
Welfare check Britomart Maccas, no issues. On standby Commercial Bay due to groups of teenagers on bikes and heavy foot traffic.
Bike group has left, all clear Commercial Bay. Patrolling Quay St.
Quay St full sweep complete, welfare checks AAS / Providor / Lulas / Rosies, no issues to report. Heading back to HQ.
Incident at Commercial Bay, big crowds and police on standby for any assistance.
Police have the situation under control, no need for assistance. Heading to HQ.
Arrived at HQ, picked up body cams.
Check-in corner of Lorne St / Wakefield, no issues. Library all clear, no issues.
Patrolling Lorne St, all clear, no issues. Heading to High St.
High St all clear, full sweep Freyberg / Chancery Square / Kitchener St, all clear, no issues to report.
Full sweep Fort St / Wilson Carpark, all clear, no issues to report.
On standby outside Sapphire showing presence.
Check-in Britomart Maccas / Commercial Bay, all clear, no issues.
Check-in Albert St Convenience Store, no issues to report.
Full sweep Victoria St, all clear, no issues.
Check-in Queen St Maccas, no issues to report. Heading back to HQ for 15 min refreshments break.
On standby at Bar 101 showing presence.
Elliot St / Darby St all clear, no issues to report. Patrolling down Queen St heading to Commercial Bay.
Queen St all clear, no issues.
On standby at Commercial Bay showing security presence.
Commercial Bay all clear, no issues.
Full sweep Fort St / Wilson Carpark, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep High St / Freyberg / Chancery Sq / Kitchener St, all clear, no issues.
Check-in corner of Lorne St / Wakefield, no issues.
Check-in Aotea Square, all clear, no issues.
Check-in Queen St Maccas, no issues. Heading back to HQ for 30 minutes break.
Break ended. On standby awaiting changeover.
